about: Search results on the real cubes, shown on the /method page (frontend/app/method) and in docs/METHOD_SEARCH.md. Every value is recomputed by search/numbers.test.ts, which fails if this file disagrees: the searches on every run, the Barnard, eps Ind B and Teegarden shuffles with P05_SHUFFLES=100, the WISE 0855 shuffles in search/significance.test.ts with P03_SHUFFLES=500. The combined-detector numbers ('multi') are recomputed by search/stackMulti.test.ts. Values are rounded as the tests print them. Motions in arcsec/yr, (RA cos Dec, Dec).

framesSeen.about: A-13: frames in which the target is seen by itself (summed flux around the search centre >= 5 x its noise). More than half: the frames are put on a common brightness before stacking.

check.about: A-13: an object that played no part in designing the common-brightness rule. Gaia DR3 35227046884571776.

barnard.about: A-13: Barnard's Star as it was searched before the common-brightness rule (normalise 'off'). With the rule its best motion is 1.66 arcsec/yr from Gaia instead of 1.12 (grid step 2.95; the requirement is under 2). Why: its saturated core is missing from the images, so the summed brightness misses a varying part of the light, and the peak fit fails there, so the reported motion is the grid cell.

epsIndB.about: Everything below is the search as it was before A-13 (frames stacked as they are, normalise 'off'): why Epsilon Indi B used to be only 'consistent'.

multi.about: P-06, P-09: several detectors in one stack (search/stackMulti.ts): frames weighted by 1/noise^2 and stacked as they are, without the common-brightness rule of A-13. The site's default search is the rows in 'objects'; its Search panel offers D5+D6 only, for faint targets (viewer/Search.tsx). Recomputed by search/stackMulti.test.ts, which fails if this disagrees (shuffles: P09_SHUFFLES=100). A row with one detector is that detector through the same weighted stacking. 'off' is from the catalogue motion; 'peak' is the brightest pixel of the best stack, arcsec east and north of the search centre.

neighbour.about: WISE 0855: the star that detectors D1-D4 show instead of the target (Gaia DR3 5756956644387831296; role A, data/cubes/wise0855/spectrum.json 'neighbour', issue #75). Arcsec east and north of the search centre. The six-detector stack peaks on it.

blank.about: WISE 0855 D5+D6 on the 8 regions 45 arcsec from the target that numbers.test.ts uses as blank sky for D6. One is not blank in D5: it holds a catalogued star (data/cubes/wise0855/catalog.json).

control.about: The control field has a D6 cube only, so D5+D6 cannot be run on it. This is its D6 cube through the weighted stacking.
